s01-summer.observed_description: One large tree full of dense dark-green leaves on a dry grassy hill under a deep-blue sky, with a wooden bench in its shade, a path in front and a red picnic blanket with a straw hat on the grass. No people; no writing.
s01-summer.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared 3:2 only). Strong sun, short shadows and the picnic blanket read as a summer day; it is the base for the three other seasons.

s05-sun.observed_description: The bright round sun with soft rays high in a clear deep-blue sky, with a strip of green treetops along the bottom edge.
s05-sun.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared 3:2 only). The meaning is plain at 180 px and nothing in the photo is written.

s06-rain.observed_description: Heavy rain falling in visible streaks onto a gray city street, with splashes in the puddles and water along the curb under a dark sky. No people or cars.
s06-rain.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared 3:2 only). The meaning is plain at 180 px and nothing in the photo is written.

s07-snow.observed_description: Snowflakes falling over a quiet street where deep white snow covers the ground, a wooden fence and the roofs of small stone houses. No people.
s07-snow.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared 3:2 only). A small snow-covered car sits far back beside one house; the falling and lying snow is still the plain subject.

s08-warm.observed_description: Ana sits on a park bench in mild sunshine with her sleeves rolled up and a light denim jacket folded beside her, face turned up to the sun with closed eyes and a relaxed smile. One person.
s08-warm.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared 3:2 only). The meaning is plain at 180 px and nothing in the photo is written.
